items.title: Nvidia says it’s ‘absurd’ to assume it predicted the agentic moment during Vera’s development
items.summary: AMD has criticized Nvidia, and to a lesser extent Arm, for claims about creating a CPU designed for agentic AI. Nvidia is pushing back on that characterization, instead saying Vera was designed with “base principles, product intuition, and oftentimes simple allegorical laws of computer science” in a recent interview with Tom’s Hardware.
